{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && mkdir -p specs/001-transactions/checklists && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Atomic Batch Transactions for TinyDB

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous
- [x] Success criteria are measurable
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined
- [x] Edge cases are identified
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- All items passed on the first validation iteration (2026-10-17);
  no spec updates were required.
- "No implementation details" was judged with the task's own contract
  language (component name `BatchWriter`, `apply(operations)`,
  `ValueError`, `_default` table) treated as the observable
  specification interface; no storage, threading, or framework choices
  are prescribed. `tinydb/journal.py` is referenced only as the
  implementation location in the milestone input, not in the spec body.
- The only milestone requirement not fully pinned down by the input is
  the handling of extra unknown fields in an operation mapping; the
  spec assumes strict shape (reject) and records it in Assumptions.
- Items marked incomplete require spec updates before `$speckit-clarify`
  or `$speckit-plan`.
EOF
echo '{"feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"}' > .specify/feature.json
echo '=== feature.json ===' && cat .specify/feature.json && echo '=== tree ===' && find specs/001-transactions -type f | sort"}
